newsitem.title: UK: Oriental Restaurant shares open at 30 pct premium.
newsitem.headline: Oriental Restaurant shares open at 30 pct premium.

text.p: Shares in Oriental Restaurant Group Plc opened at a 46p premium to the placing price of 154p on their first day of trade on the London Stock Exchange on Thursday.
The shares began trading at 200p but pared gains to 187.5p by 1130 GMT. Volume was just over half a million shares.
"The shares were greatly sought after in the placing," said a spokesman for the company.
The restaurant operator and oriental grocery supplier raised 3.5 million stg via the flotation, valuing the company at 14.7 million stg.
Proceeds from the issue will be used to finance expansion plans in the London area, the spokesman said.
